'''Joodiel Amgris''' was a native of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Varonat/Legends|Varonat]], located on the [[Ison Trade Corridor/Legends|Ison Corridor]]<ref name="FC" /> in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA-OC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Amgris lived in [[Tropis-on-Varonat]], and around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], a [[Krish (species)/Legends|Krish]] named [[Gamgalon]] arrived on the planet and began organizing safaris [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] the [[Morodin/Legends|Morodin]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of giant [[Diet/Legends|herbivores]], out of the settlement that boosted the local economy.<ref name="FC" />

In response, Amgris opened [[Great Jungle Outfitters]], a store that sold hunting gear exclusively to the individuals who participated in Gamgalon's hunting expeditions. Conveniently located by Tropis-on-Varonat's landing field next to a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]], Amgris's equipment was always brand new and looked to be fresh-out-of-the-box when worn by the customers. Amgris was an enterprising individual who was able to astutely establish a new business that served a large [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|money]]-making enterprise such as Gamgalon's safaris.<ref name="FC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Joodiel Amgris was mentioned in the supplementary [[Roleplaying game|RPG]] material that accompanied [[Timothy Zahn]]'s ''[[First Contact]]'', which was published in [[1994]]'s [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 1|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 1]] by [[West End Games]]. The extra background material was written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer]]. Because Amgris only appeared in the supplementary information, the character was not mentioned when the story was reprinted in ''[[Tales from the Empire]]'' or on [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|''Hyperspace'']], as neither reproduced the RPG material that accompanied the original story.
